eyebrow: A freshness SLA is a number, not a vibe
code:
Vague:     "the dashboard should be pretty current"
Concrete:  "inventory reflects any sale from more than
            5 min ago, 99% of updates land inside 2 min"
caption: If it can't be measured, it isn't an SLA.

eyebrow: The processing model sets the ceiling
code:
Nightly batch          --> freshness in HOURS
Micro-batch every 5min --> freshness in MINUTES
True event streaming   --> freshness in SECONDS
(Fabric Eventstreams + KQL, Lessons 19/21)
caption: Lesson 5's choice already decided the answer.

code:
Hours    -- one scheduled batch run, compute idle after
Minutes  -- frequent micro-batches, bursty
Seconds  -- continuously running compute, always-on cost
caption: How fresh does this consumer actually need it to be?
